messages.text: Priya sent a useful boundary: 48k rows finishes in 1m34s; 52k reaches the two-minute worker limit. Interactive retry works, scheduled retry does not.
I can reproduce it. The scheduler still passes the old timeout to the export worker. Fix is small; the load test is not.
Please do not merge on the small fixture alone. Run 50k, 75k, and a cancelled job. If cancellation leaks workers, 2.8 waits.
Account note: invoice 4471 is open, but it is not overdue until the 30th. Keep billing out of the incident reply unless Priya asks.

documents.name: Theo — first week.md

mail.body_text:
Hi Maya,

The manual retry Samira suggested finished, but last night's scheduled export stopped at exactly two minutes again. We are using the same saved export with 52,184 rows.

I have a renewal review on Tuesday. I do not need a final fix before then, but I do need a clear workaround and an honest date.

Priya
mail.snippet: The manual retry finished, but last night's scheduled export stopped at exactly two minutes again.
mail.subject: Export is still timing out on our scheduled account run

mail.body_text:
Maya,

For the renewal brief: invoice 4471 is open for 412.00 USD and due on 30 August. It is not late. Priya confirmed the billing address last week, so there is no finance action unless it remains open after month-end.

Noor
mail.snippet: Invoice 4471 is open for 412.00 and due on the 30th, so it is not late.
mail.subject: Lumen account note before Tuesday

mail.body_text:
Commercial section is done. Usage grew 38% since February and they added the compliance workspace in June.

I left the export incident paragraph marked in yellow. Please replace it after Jon decides whether the fix is in 2.8.

David
mail.snippet: Commercial section is done. I left the export incident paragraph marked in yellow.
mail.subject: Draft Lumen renewal brief — needs the technical paragraph

mail.body_text:
Hello Maya,

The courier moved the delivery to Monday between 08:00 and 10:00. The desk riser is in the same shipment. No signature is required.

Fern
mail.snippet: The courier moved the delivery to Monday between 08:00 and 10:00.
mail.subject: Delivery window for Theo's chair

mail.body_text:
This week: queue visibility metrics, a new Paris region, and planned maintenance in Toronto. Northstar's London workloads are not affected.

You receive this because you are an account owner.
mail.snippet: Three platform notes and a maintenance window that does not affect your region.
mail.subject: CloudHarbor weekly: queues, regions, and maintenance

mail.body_text:
Hi Priya,

We reproduced the difference between manual and scheduled runs. The scheduler is passing the old two-minute limit to the worker.

We are testing the focused fix against larger exports and cancellation today. Samira will send you a safe workaround before 15:00, even if the release date is not final by then.

Maya
mail.snippet: We reproduced the scheduled-run difference and are testing the fix against larger exports today.
mail.subject: Re: Export is still timing out on our scheduled account run

mail.body_text:
Hi Maya,

The manual retry completed in one minute and forty seconds. The scheduled run still stopped at two minutes, so the workaround is usable but not safe to leave in place.

Please send the short-term steps before the renewal call.

Priya
mail.snippet: The manual retry completed, but the scheduled run still stopped at two minutes.
mail.subject: Re: Export is still timing out on our scheduled account run

mail.body_text:
Hi Priya,

Use the manual retry with the saved export and keep the browser tab open until the download starts. We will update you after the 50k and cancellation checks.

Maya
mail.snippet: Use the manual retry with the saved export until the load and cancellation checks finish.
mail.subject: Re: Export is still timing out on our scheduled account run

mail.body_text: The 50k load test passed. The 75k run is still in progress, and cancellation left one worker busy for three minutes. I am checking whether that is cleanup or a leak before I call it green.
mail.snippet: The 50k load test passed; the 75k run and cancellation cleanup still need review.
mail.subject: Export worker load-test results

mail.body_text: Please keep the release gate closed until the cancellation result is explained. A fast success at 50k is useful, but it does not prove that a cancelled 75k job releases its worker.
mail.snippet: Keep the release gate closed until the cancelled 75k job is understood.
mail.subject: Re: Export worker load-test results

mail.body_text: The release notes are ready for review. I called out saved views and export retries, but I left the timeout wording neutral until Jon confirms the cancellation result.
mail.snippet: Release notes are ready; the timeout wording stays neutral until the gate is clear.
mail.subject: 2.8 release notes ready for review

mail.body_text: I added the commercial section to the Lumen brief. Please check the usage sentence and the paragraph about the export incident before Tuesday.
mail.snippet: The commercial section is ready; please check the usage and export paragraphs.
mail.subject: Lumen renewal brief — final review

mail.body_text: Please submit August expenses before 16:00. A missing receipt can wait until Monday, but every amount and customer must be entered today.
mail.snippet: Submit August expenses before 16:00; missing receipts can wait until Monday.
mail.subject: August expense reminder

mail.body_text: I entered the two customer expenses. I will add the remaining receipt after the supplier sends the copy.
mail.snippet: The two customer expenses are entered; the last receipt is pending the supplier copy.
mail.subject: Re: August expense reminder

mail.body_text: I can access the repository, but I still need an owner for the staging account. Is that with Jon or Lucas? I will finish the checklist after the answer.
mail.snippet: The repository works, but the staging account still needs an owner.
mail.subject: Theo onboarding — staging access

mail.body_text: I assigned the support queue hand-off to Samira and left staging access open for Jon. The checklist is ready for your review.
mail.snippet: The support hand-off is assigned and staging access is open for Jon.
mail.subject: Re: Theo onboarding — staging access

mail.body_text: The export dashboard is useful, but the overnight report still has a blank customer column. Can you confirm whether the new retry worker changes the report format?
mail.snippet: The overnight report has a blank customer column after the retry change.
mail.subject: Question about the overnight export report

mail.body_text: The retry worker should not change the report shape. Please send one run ID and I will compare it with the last successful export.
mail.snippet: The retry worker should not change the report shape; send one run ID for comparison.
mail.subject: Re: Question about the overnight export report

mail.body_text: I attached a copy of invoice 4471 and the current account note. The amount is unchanged, and the due date remains the end of the month.
mail.snippet: Invoice 4471 is unchanged; the current account note is attached.
mail.subject: Invoice 4471 — account copy

mail.body_text: The courier moved Theo's desk delivery to Monday between 08:00 and 10:00. No signature is required.
mail.snippet: Theo's desk delivery moved to Monday between 08:00 and 10:00.
mail.subject: Delivery window for Theo's desk

mail.body_text: This week's platform notes cover queue visibility, a new Paris region and planned Toronto maintenance. London workloads are not affected.
mail.snippet: Queue visibility, a new Paris region and Toronto maintenance are in this week's notes.
mail.subject: CloudHarbor weekly: regions and maintenance

mail.body_text: The audit page review found one timezone label bug. It is visual only, so I opened a separate issue and kept it out of the export branch.
mail.snippet: The timezone label bug is visual only and is tracked outside the export branch.
mail.subject: Audit page review — timezone label

mail.body_text: Thanks. Keep it out of the export branch and add the screenshot to the release review so we do not lose the context.
mail.snippet: Keep the visual issue separate and add its screenshot to the release review.
mail.subject: Re: Audit page review — timezone label

mail.body_text: We still need the retention, export access and audit-log answers before the security review can close. A short table is enough.
mail.snippet: Retention, export access and audit-log answers are still needed for the security review.
mail.subject: Security review follow-up

mail.body_text: I will send the retention and export answers today. I am checking the audit-log owner with Samira before I make the final table.
mail.snippet: I will send the retention and export answers today after confirming the audit-log owner.
mail.subject: Re: Security review follow-up
